---
title: Bombes d'aigua al mapa de John Snow
lang: ca
ref: figura-john-snow-pous
format: gfm
execute-dir: project
execute: {echo: false, warning: false}
unaltraweb_compute:
  engine: python
  mode: figure
  inputs:
    - assets/img/historia/john-snow-1855.jpg
    - context/inputs/snow-pous.json
  outputs: [assets/img/generated/john-snow-pous.svg]
---

```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import base64,hashlib,json
from xml.sax.saxutils import escape
root=Path.cwd()
while not (root/'.unaltraweb/computations.yml').exists():
    if root==root.parent:raise RuntimeError('Projecte absent')
    root=root.parent
d=json.loads((root/'context/inputs/snow-pous.json').read_text())
source=(root/d['source']).read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest()==d['source_sha256']
assert len(d['pumps'])==13 and len({p['id'] for p in d['pumps']})==13
w,h=d['width'],d['height'];r=d['radius']
parts=[f'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" width="{w}" height="{h}" viewBox="0 0 {w} {h}">',
    '<title>Mapa de John Snow amb les bombes d’aigua assenyalades</title>',
    '<desc>Mapa de 1855 conservat com a imatge de fons. Tretze cercles blaus afegits identifiquen els símbols PUMP; no representen distàncies ni àrees d’influència.</desc>',
    '<metadata>'+escape(json.dumps({'source':d['source'],'source_sha256':d['source_sha256'],'rights':d['rights'],'annotation':'Blue visual callouts added for the manual'},ensure_ascii=False))+'</metadata>',
    f'<rect width="{w}" height="{h}" fill="white"/>',
    '<g id="mapa-original"><image width="'+str(w)+'" height="'+str(h)+'" xlink:href="data:image/jpeg;base64,'+base64.b64encode(source).decode()+'"/></g>',
    f'<g id="bombes-aigua" fill="none" stroke="{d["stroke"]}" stroke-width="{d["stroke_width"]}">']
for pump in d['pumps']:
    x,y=pump['x'],pump['y'];assert r<=x<=w-r and r<=y<=h-r
    parts.append(f'<circle id="{pump["id"]}" cx="{x}" cy="{y}" r="{r}"><title>Bomba d’aigua</title></circle>')
parts+=['</g>','</svg>']
(root/'assets/img/generated/john-snow-pous.svg').write_text('\n'.join(parts)+'\n')
```
